value.rationale: An all-dimensional Jordan-chain test problem is a natural nonnormal stress test for stochastic time discretization, and the sharp closed parameter boundary gives precise permissible steps for all m and diagnoses mean-stable yet variance-unstable numerical dynamics. The dimension-dependent binomial loop and strict no-reentry assertion are structural rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice. Does not generalize to arbitrary drifts.
